title: Cloud Cost Compare
summary: Price the selected VMs on Azure and AWS side by side, and against negotiated or private-cloud rate cards.
author: RVTools Analyzer examples

parameters.label: Price lists
parameters.help: The private cloud rate card is bundled with this solution. Import examples/price-lists/example-azure-ea.rvaprices in Settings › Price Lists for the negotiated rates.

parameters.label: Bring your own Windows Server licences
parameters.help: Azure Hybrid Benefit / AWS BYOL: Windows VMs are priced at the Linux rate.

parameters.label: Right-size from observed usage
parameters.help: Uses CPU and consumed memory from the export plus the buffer. RVTools is a point-in-time snapshot — validate with performance history.
